title: Sits low to the ground for a tv
text:
Sits low to the ground for a tv. This thing is reasonably simple for one person to put together. But it is heavy. It looks nice once it's all assembled. Unfortunately, it's short and our tv is way too close to the floor on it. We have rowdy dogs and it would be just a matter of time before they slammed into it and broke something.

Instead, I'm converting the shelves into wall shelves in a spare room. They will make a nice display area for photos and the like.
